policy: READ-ONLY. claimbox is the producer (the claim-machine); this manifest copies its pinned Riemann records and corpus OUT, for the companion paper riemann-finite-layer, and never writes back. The build reads the copies under corpus/claimbox-riemann only; `make drift` re-hashes both ends and names what moved, and PROVENANCE-claimbox.json records the claimbox commit the copies came from. Operator-approved 2026-10-22 as the one exception to CLAUDE.md's 'nothing here reads claimbox'. Extended by the operator on 2026-10-31 for the x^x = y report (reports/xx.html): claimbox's x^x records, its sources and the two files they rest on (the proposer's computation and the reduction, read, never run here) are copied into corpus/claimbox-xx, and tools/run-xx-ledger.py re-decides every bracket from them with code of its own.
